tagline: Creating happiness through storytelling and innovation
hero_kpi_rationale: Disney generates $84.6 billion in recurring revenue (DTC subscriptions, parks), representing 90% of total revenue, a major strategic shift toward a subscription model driven by Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: The portion of revenue that remains after paying direct costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin is improving due to better production cost management and growth in higher-margin services.
kpis.signal: Rising gross margin despite cost pressures

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is increasing significantly due to lower amortization and restructuring expenses.
kpis.signal: Strong rebound in operating margin following heavy impairments last year

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.explanation: Amount the company spends on innovation relative to its revenue.
kpis.description: Disney does not report separate R&D expenses, as its innovation is primarily driven by creative content and experiences.
kpis.signal: No distinct R&D line item in the 10-K

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (parks & platforms)
kpis.explanation: Money spent to build or upgrade physical facilities and digital platforms.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures are rising to support park modernization and DTC platform development.
kpis.signal: Increased capex to modernize parks and DTC platforms

kpis.name: Service / Subscription Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue earned regularly from subscriptions such as Disney+ or Hulu, and parks.
kpis.description: Service revenue, driven by DTC subscriptions and parks, accounts for 90% of total revenue.
kpis.signal: Stable growth in recurring revenue despite competition

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: Disney is reducing headcount to improve productivity following rapid DTC growth and the Star India transaction.

kpis.name: Direct-to-Consumer Margin
kpis.explanation: Profitability of subscription streaming operations (Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+).
kpis.description: Disney has achieved profitability in its DTC operations, marking a strategic turning point after years of heavy investment.
kpis.signal: DTC profitability achieved, a major strategic milestone

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: The portion of revenue that remains after paying direct costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin is improving due to better production cost management and growth in higher-margin services.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 7 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total Revenue of $94.425 Bn last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net Income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 7 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net Income of $12.404 Bn last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating Income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 7 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating Income of $17.551 Bn last fiscal year (FY2025).
